title: Run the loyalty points migration on production
text: Lane B cannot reach the production database. Run these three in order in the SQL console and check each result.

sql.title: 1 of 3: add the points column
2 of 3: backfill from past orders
sql.query:
UPDATE customers c
SET loyalty_points = sub.points
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, FLOOR(SUM(total) / 10) AS points
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'paid'
  GROUP BY customer_id
) sub
WHERE sub.customer_id = c.id;
sql.expect: UPDATE with a row count close to the number of customers who have paid (about 1,200).

sql.title: 3 of 3: check it
sql.query:
-- Nobody should have negative points
SELECT count(*) AS bad
FROM customers
WHERE loyalty_points < 0;
